data_source: Yahoo Finance adjusted daily prices; USD portfolio and ACWI benchmark converted to EUR using EURUSD=X

methodology.decision_timing: previous month-end close; execute from next month
methodology.reporting_currency: EUR; USD asset returns converted monthly using EURUSD=X (USD per EUR)
methodology.regions: Developed, Asia, South America, Africa & Middle East (fourth sleeve approximate)
methodology.warning: Independent approximation, not Logical Invest formula. US-listed research tickers; excludes fees, taxes, slippage and FX. Sharpe/Sortino here use zero risk-free/target assumptions and are not directly comparable with Logical Invest.
